name: Desert of Glass Flowers with a Traveling Caravan
description: A desert covered in translucent glass flowers is crossed by a small caravan of carts and gentle animals under a dramatic sky.
prompt: A single wide cinematic image of a desert filled with translucent glass flowers in blue, amber, and violet. A small caravan of carts and gentle animals crosses the dunes, iridescent light refracting through petals, warm sand, dramatic sky, surreal nature, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Even deserts can bloom in glass.
